name: kxwti
title: Will WTI crude oil settle above a given strike price on Oct 9, 2026?
settlement: If the daily settlement price for WTI crude oil (November 2026 contract) on October 09, 2026 is above the strike, the market resolves to Yes. Settlement uses the nearest listed contract month, rolling forward 2 business days before expiry, rounded to 2 decimal places.
decideContext: You are estimating how much a news item shifts the WTI crude oil daily settlement price (near-month futures, USD/Bbl) as of Oct 9, 2026; the market resolves Yes if that settlement price is above the listed strike.
